newsitem.title: USA: Cell Therapeutics says drug shown effective.
newsitem.headline: Cell Therapeutics says drug shown effective.

text.p: Cell Therapeutics Inc said Wednesday that preliminary results of Phase II trials show its lead drug candidate, lisofylline, showed it significantly reduced serious neutropenic infections in patients undergoing chemotherapy.
The company said that patients receiving the lisofylline, or LSF drug, showed 50 percent fewer serious neutropenic infections than placebo recipients.
Neutropenic infections, which can be fatal, result from a reduction in a patient's infection-fighting white blood cell count following chemotherapy.
